main_body: snow-covered wooden fence/screen or drying rack
top_band: white/light blue-grey snow cap on rows 1-8
evidence: The object has a clear 8-row foreshortened snow top (rows 1-8) with icicles/overhang at row 9 and a 16-row wooden lattice/fence front face below (rows 9-24). However, it is a man-made wooden structure/fence/prop covered in snow, not an organic object (plants, rocks, firewood).

style.evidence: The snow cap has decent shading (white to blue-grey) and icicle details, and the dark outlines are tinted, but the tan wooden panels on the front face (e.g., rows 9-12, 15-16, 19-22) are completely flat single-colour fills with no wood grain or tonal variation compared to the textured Beodeul stall and well.
